title: Use AgentsKit from Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor
problem: Developers should be able to use the same AgentsKit tools and agents inside their existing coding agent without building or maintaining a separate integration for every host.
audience: JavaScript and TypeScript developers using Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or another MCP-compatible host

executable.expectStdoutIncludes: verified hosts: claude, codex, cursor; cli tools: fetch_url, web_search

commands: codex mcp add agentskit -- npx -y @agentskit/mcp@0.3.3 --tools fetch,search
claude mcp add --scope project --transport stdio agentskit -- npx -y @agentskit/mcp@0.3.3 --tools fetch,search
